Name: Well Read - Small Expansion
Author: Luminte
Description:
[size=3]Adds an entrance to a [b]T[/b][b]ree House[/b] behind where the [b]Traveling Cart[/b] arrives. [/size]

[size=3]The T[/size][size=3]ree H[/size][size=3]ouse [/size][size=3]contains[/size][size=3] t[/size][size=3]wo shops:[/size]

[size=3]One of the shops is run by[/size] [size=3]Ossi and Calus, a Crow and Grackle who are husbands and like reading books.[/size][size=3] They sell[/size][size=3] Tea, Rasins, [b]New [/b][/size][size=3][b]Seeds[/b], [/size][size=3]and other random bits and bobs.[/size]

[size=3]The other shop is run by a mouse named Scritch who is constantly reading books, trying to soak up all the knowledge the world has to give them. They sell Random Skill Books and [b]New B[/b][b]ooks[/b] that they've made.[/size]

[size=3][b]New Books:[/b][/size]
[spoiler]Scritch Unique Book Stock:
Talking to Crops: Wheat - Small chance to gain cooked dishes associated with Wheat when harvesting it. (Vanilla Dishes only)
Talking to Crops: Corn -  Small chance to gain cooked dishes associated with Corn when harvesting it. (Vanilla Dishes only) 
Children's Book - When Catching two or more fish at once receive a random red or blue fish.
Camper's Guide - Resources required to craft Tent Kit reduced. (Happens overnight)
Invisible Book - Use for a random book from the Scritch's collection.
Nest Egg: Building Wealth - Add 1000g to the value of this book per day for 1 year, Using the book claims it.
The Luck of The Cat -  Cats always give gifts when at max friendship.
Dog Tales - Dogs always give gifts when at max friendship. 
Scute n Scoot - Turtles always give gifts when at max friendship.

Lewis' Trash:
Lost Wallet - Gain cash back from traveling to the Desert or Ginger Island.[/spoiler]
[size=3][b]New Crops:[/b][/size]
[spoiler]Bird Shop Seasonal Stock:
Honey Melon - Plant in the spring. Takes 12 days to mature.
Oca - Plant in warm weather. Takes 15 days to mature. Grows faster if planted near a body of water.
Yacon -  Plant in fall. Takes 9 days to mature. Grows faster if planted near a body of water.
Chocolate Mint - Plant in the winter. Takes 7 days to grow, but keeps producing after that.(Sold as a sapling/bush if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]Custom Bush[/url] is installed)[/spoiler]
[size=3][b]New Berry Season:[/b][/size]
[size=3]From Spring 28th to Summer 4th [b]Cloudberries[/b] will be harvestable from bushes! If you dont want the Cloudberries for any reason, you can remove the "[BBM] Well Read" folder from this mod and they wont appear.[/size]

[size=4][b]Bundles:[/b][/size]
[size=3]There's a computer in the tree house that gives seasonal bundles with increasing difficulty over time(increases until year 3). 6 bundles are available per season, and will be removed once the season is over.[/size]

[size=3]The bundles are basically like a quest board and will have one random type of item asked per bundle with an increasing amount and quality(for some) being requested. Bundles should continue every year[/size]

[size=3][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]
[size=3]Well Read should be compatible with most mods, including expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, as it only edits a small area.[/size]

[size=3][b]Credit:[/b][/size]
[size=3]Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DolphinIsNotaFish]DolphinIsNotAFish[/url] for letting me edit their portrait of the Hat Mouse from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20414]TDIT[/url] for Scritch's portrait[/size]

[size=3][b]Translations:[/b][/size]
[size=3]Spanish Translations by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/NandemoXV]Nandemo[/url][/size]

[size=3][b]Cool Stuff/Mod Recs[/b][b]:[/b][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Howaa]Howaa[/url] made some [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50561]Nyapu-style portraits[/url] for Ossi, Calus, and Scritch which are very cute, go check them out! :D [/size]

[size=3][b]Let me know if you find any bugs or have suggestions![/b][/size]
